notes.title: SFD 3.0 Update
notes.content: [p]*Warning: Save files from the previous version are not compatible. If you want to continue from the previous version, right-click SFD, select Betas, and switch to the Beta version to play.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]It has been a long time since the last update.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]SFD had stopped receiving updates in favor of Crawl Tactics, but after hearing about an achievement bug, I fixed the bug and added a new mode and UI update. This will likely be the final update for SFD.[/p][p align="start"][/p][olist][*][p align="start"]Custom Mode Added: You can now choose one of the basic mercenaries to start with instead of the Adventurer.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Easy Mode Improvements: In Easy Mode, mercenaries (other than the leader) revive after battle if you win, with some HP restored. Also, the Stalling Punishment no longer occurs in Easy Mode.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Dark Apprentice Mage Added: A low-level dark mage who can advance to Necromancer.[/p][/*][*][p]UI Improvements: The overall UI has been improved.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][/p][/*][/olist]

tags.feature: Custom Mode Added: You can now choose one of the basic mercenaries to start with instead of the Adventurer.
Dark Apprentice Mage Added: A low-level dark mage who can advance to Necromancer.
UI Improvements: The overall UI has been improved.

notes.title: Announce Tranfinite Dungeon: The sequel to SFD
notes.content:
Transfinite dungeon's steam page is made and the first playable demo is out.

[url=https://www.dropbox.com/sh/wq37slmgaxq294n/AACnUvsW8N54pZ1VHRnKHvbSa?dl=0]Link of the demo[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1290750/]Steam page[/url]

 I released the demo to test the battle mechanic
1. Elemental interaction like ice magic freezes water and prevent enemies from moving, lightning magic gives additional splash damages on water, etc... 
2. Delayed magic which is cast after enemies' turn but powerful) It has only battle part yet and no tutorial.

 I would be very thankful if you try the demo and give some impressions about it on the steam page.

notes.title: SFD v2.42
notes.content:
18-10-03 v2.42

*Game changes

- Confirming action button appear when trying friendly fire even if 'confirm action' option is unchecked in settings menu.
  Hopefully this will prevents many miss clicks.
- Now mouse wheel scrolling will cycle through available abilities. zoom in and out buttons are changed to '+' and '-'.
- Right mouse button click cancels ability or undo move.
- Tab key or number keys change character even when selecting target after selecting ability.
- Added 'NEXT' and 'PREV'  buttons to change character on inventory window and information window. (Short cut key for NEXT button is Tab)
- Room icon of mini map is changed to empty room icon after clear enemies or activate shrine etc.
- Accessories are not auto equipped.
- Changed turn effect mechanism. Now turn effect will disappear end of phase, not start of phase.
- Accuracy of Bows and swords are decreased.
- RESTRICT RESIST increase temporarily when a character is stunned. This will prevent abusing stun abilities.
- Accuracy of basic melee and ranged attack ability is decreased (Melee attack, Shoot arrow, Spear attack ...)

- Job berserker got new passive abilities : Evade, Natural resistance
- Job berserker got new ability : Critical strike
- Job defender got new passive ability : Defender's heart
- Job engineer got new ability : Shoot dual gun
- Job assassin got new ability : Concentrated strike

- Duration of Stun skills are decreased.
- Ability inferno's damage is increased.
- Chain lighting hitting 3 times when skill level is below 3 and hitting 4 times after skill level 3.
  (It hits 4 times regardless of skill level in earlier versions)
- Ability Fire ball's splash range increased when skill level become 4.


- Added new item: screaming stone
- Added new abilities : Dual gun attack, Critical strike, Concentrated strike, Evade, Natural resistance, Defender's heart

*Bug fixes

- 'Allies positioned weirdly when the door is near corner' bug fixed.

- 'Ability buttons are not working after battle begin randomly' bug is fixed.
- 'Crashing when repeatedly start new game' bug is fixed.
- Tool tip of quick slot and item slot disappearing bug fixed.
- Now mouse wheel work as expected. ( Scrolled when on scroll pane and zoom in/out on game screen)
- necessity condition of memorizing magic scroll is informed properly.
- Cancel button disappearing bug fixed.

tags.feature: - Now you can move to already visited room quickly by clicking minimap or pressing F5.
- Short cut key added: Esc to Cancel abilitiy or Closed window.

tags.bug: - Set direction Ability can be canceled and freezing bug when clicking end turn button on set direction fixed.
- Small typo fixed.

tags.feature: - Now you can break destructable obstacle even if not in the battle by just clicking it.

tags.balance_change: - Odds of gold and item spawned by breaking crates are decreased.
- You cannot break firebowl in 'no enemy' room.

tags.feature: - Korean language supported.
- Now you can play as easy mode.

tags.balance_change: - Holy magic that heals normal character damages undeads.

tags.feature: - Each characters can equip assessories. (Like ring or boots ..)
- Fire breathing dragon statue and button are added. The statue breathe fire when object is on near buttons of it.
- Blight explosive barrel is added. It will not destroy obstacles and only poison enemies or allies.

tags.balance_change: - Names of equipments are changed from sword0 1 2.. to some 'plausible' names.
- Ability like spider web and Entangle increases move resist of subject.(Turn effect Stuck is added)

tags.feature: - You can choose to confirm action or not in config menu (Default option is not confirm. Thus now one click is suffice doing some action.)
- Keyboard shortcut key for mouse click (Space bar button) added.
- Some magic items are added.
- Final boss Nog the false god is added.
- Floor bosses are changed and cyclops is removed. Stone golem king's sprites are changed.

tags.bug: - Room clear treat is changed. (Choice will appear 2 among 4(+Exp,Health,Gold,Item). Gold is not appear if not selected as a treat)

tags.balance_change: - Dual wielding ability got better(Acc and Dmg).

tags.feature: - Engineer can change job to gunner or chemist.

tags.bug: - Now move resist works properly
